title: MoT translators compressed into Mirror logical experts
hypothesis: A shared translator basis plus per-expert Mirror codes and a private fallback will preserve the routed target trajectory while reducing serialized payload against native full MoT, and beat an ordinary shared matrix-bank control.
mirror_coordinate: eight per-expert Givens angles that rotate one shared translator output; private full matrix for the unrelated expert
logical_multiplicity: six routed translator experts; five aligned, one unrelated private expert

selection.method: secrets.randbelow over sorted eligible P0/UNTESTED IDs after exclusions
selection.pool_exclusions: completed worker IDs and paused families documented in previous draw records

task.expert_matrix_structure: five experts are per-output Givens rotations of one full-rank shared translator; one unrelated expert is stored privately
task.view_code_provenance: per-expert Givens angles are supplied by the synthetic teacher and charged; code-learning is not claimed

native_mot_components: input-conditioned soft router with top-2 mixture
target-context correction map added at every trajectory step

development.selection_metric: for each low-rank control choose smallest q/r with normalized trajectory MSE <=1e-4; no fresh tuning

success_gate: All three fresh worlds have normalized target trajectory MSE <=1e-4; Mirror payload <=0.80x native full MoT; Mirror active MAC proxy <=1.25x native full MoT; and Mirror payload <=0.90x the nearest ordinary shared matrix-bank or independent-rank control at matched quality.
failure_gate: Any fresh quality/compute/storage gate is missed, or the ordinary shared matrix-bank control matches Mirror quality and bytes within 10%.
boundaries: Synthetic vector translator mechanism only; no actual heterogeneous LLM cache or Transformer trajectory KL.
Router and target context correction are present in every primary method and fully charged.
Five aligned experts are deliberately generated from the tested shared basis; one unrelated expert is private.
No learned router, real cache layout, calibration corpus, or end-to-end source prefill is tested.
Context correction is a synthetic target-context input map; no MoT trajectory-correction loss is trained or replicated.
Per-expert angles are supplied teacher metadata rather than fitted from model-pair calibration data.

protocol_amendments.reason: The first verification review found that setup decomposition cost was listed but not represented in the core rows. Added a separate deterministic SVD-shape/flop proxy and measured setup wall time; no model setting, fresh metric, or selection changed.
